properties.name: Nebro
properties.selection: stratified random by cropland area, seed 87618
properties.note: Farm calibration area for the ground-PV detector, drawn by scripts/propose_calibration_candidates.py --farmland: a cropland-weighted random cell from cropland stratum 7 of 8: 82.2%-86.4% cropland (cell), then a 3 km window inside it whose own cropland share (85.0%, ESA WorldCover) is within 25% of the cell's (84.0%). Map ALL solar inside, ground and rooftop, tracing the panels rather than the fence. Esri imagery here dates from 2025-04-20 (oldest of centre and corners), no older than 2025-04-01 for a composite starting 2026-04-01. Register with new_calibration_quadrat.py --farm. Not checked on the ground: confirm it is mappable before you start, and do not move it toward visible solar.
